collections.description: Stores profile information for registered SaaS customers (store owners)

fields.name: uid
fields.description: Firebase Auth UID

fields.name: email
fields.description: Email address of the store owner

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Display name of the user

fields.name: connectedPages
fields.description: List of connected social media page configuration objects (mocked tokens, page IDs, names, and active statuses)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Account registration date

collections.description: Stores shop specifics, items list, delivery, and conversational tone definitions

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Foreign key reference to users.uid

fields.name: kbProducts
fields.description: Freeform details about shop offerings, models, or variants

fields.name: kbPricing
fields.description: Prices, packages, cash-on-delivery (COD) settings

fields.name: kbShipping
fields.description: Courier costs, geographical delivery zones, and fulfillment windows

fields.name: dialect
fields.description: Conversational Arabic accent setting (egyptian or standard)

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Last time the store owner edited their products/prices/shipping details

collections.description: Main history log for all AI auto-replies generated for comments and direct messages

fields.name: userId
fields.description: UID of the store owner who owns this page integration

fields.name: customerName
fields.description: User handle or display name of the social media user who commented or sent DM

fields.name: messageText
fields.description: Raw trigger message or comment text from the end user

fields.name: commentReply
fields.description: The comment reply text published (if triggerType is comment)

fields.name: dmReply
fields.description: The private message (DM) text sent to the user

fields.name: platform
fields.description: The source platform (facebook or instagram)

fields.name: triggerType
fields.description: Whether triggered by a public post comment or direct message (comment or dm)

fields.name: status
fields.description: The delivery outcome (sent or failed)

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time the AI response was successfully synthesized and recorded
